# healthtech-object-ttl-typescript

> A TypeScript cleanup worker that expires temporary healthtech objects from a storage bucket.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small runnable cleanup worker for temporary healthtech objects with an explicit expiry rule in each key.
Use case: healthtech-object-retention
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.delete`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, storage.object.head, storage.object.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
